mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals tightening monetary policy, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) alongside falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable environment for equity valuation growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising demand and falling rates does not occur in 60-day windows, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: High GDP growth (GDPC1) in a late-cycle expansion indicates robust corporate earnings and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in late-cycle periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Surging employment (PAYEMS) above 1.4 million indicates strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weak supply-side growth, prompting investors to anticipate higher growth and lower inflation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Post-recession GDP growth (GDPC1) in a demand rebound phase signals recovery, improving corporate earnings and investor sentiment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in post-recession periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) coupled with higher federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signals tightening labor markets and higher interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising unemployment and higher rates does not occur in 5-day windows, or 5-day forward returns in such instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite the signal.
